items.title_kr: Kohl's, 56개 Babies R Us shop-in-shop 확장하며 partnership 강화
items.title_en: Kohl's Opening 56 Babies R Us Shops, Expanding Partnership
items.body_kr: Kohl's가 Babies R Us와의 partnership을 확대하며 56개 offline store에 shop-in-shop을 입점시킵니다. Sephora 실적 정체 속 키즈 merchandise 부문의 traffic 반등을 노리는 전략입니다.
items.body_en: Kohl's is expanding its partnership with Babies R Us by launching 56 in-store shops. This move aims to drive traffic in kids merchandise as Sephora growth faces headwinds.

items.title_kr: Macy's, Goldman Sachs conference에서 성장 전략 및 실적 모멘텀 강조
items.title_en: Macy’s at Goldman Sachs conference: strategy gains momentum
items.body_kr: Macy's 경영진이 Goldman Sachs conference에 참석해 최근의 전략적 실행력과 실적 모멘텀을 강조했습니다. Flagship modernization과 멀티 브랜드 포트폴리오 개선이 긍정적 평가를 받고 있습니다.
items.body_en: Macy's management highlighted its ongoing strategic execution and momentum at the Goldman Sachs conference. Flagship modernization and multi-brand portfolio gains are driving optimism.

items.title_kr: Target과 Hollister Collaboration home goods, 데이터 분석에서 긍정적 성과 기록
items.title_en: Target and Hollister collab is a win for home goods: data
items.body_kr: Target과 Hollister의 Collaboration 라인이 home goods category에서 뛰어난 데이터 성과를 거두며 주목받고 있습니다. 이종 브랜드 간의 협업이 젊은 층 consumer demand를 성공적으로 견인 중입니다.
items.body_en: The collaboration between Target and Hollister is showing strong data performance in home goods. Cross-brand partnerships continue to successfully drive younger consumer demand.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, 'KPop Demon Hunters' inspired collection 출시하며 Z세대 공략
items.title_en: Kohl’s ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ inspired collection: Products and availability
items.body_kr: Kohl's has launched a pop culture-inspired collection targeting younger consumer demand. Such IP-driven merchandise strategies offer useful direction for vendor assortment planning.

items.title_kr: Macy's, 미국 패션 조명하는 2026 Fall Fashion Campaign 공개
items.title_en: Macy’s Unveils Its 2026 Fall Fashion Campaign Featuring a Celebration of American Fashion
items.body_kr: Macy's has unveiled its new fall campaign celebrating American fashion heritage. This marks an early marketing push in the apparel category ahead of the upcoming holiday season.
